items.context: Can I reschedule your delivery for tomorrow?
items.text: haan ji

items.context: What time would you prefer for delivery?
items.text: subah 10 baje

items.context: Do you want to cancel the delivery instead?
items.text: nahi chahiye
mera address hai sector 22 chandigarh delivery kal kar do
kya aap mera delivery time 5 baje se badal kar 7 baje kar sakte ho
main meerut me rahata hun aur kal ka din busy hun isliye badalna hai
mera naam rahul hai aur mera order delhi ke liye reschedule karna hai
delivery lene wala mera bhai hai to kya main time change kar sakta hun
mujhe kal raat ko 8 baje ki jagah subah 9 baje chahiye hoga
kya aap sunday ko delivery provide kar sakte ho mera address gurgaon me hai

items.context: When would you like to reschedule the delivery to?
items.text: main schedule change karna chahta hun lekin kal nahi reporting pe

items.context: Please tell me the new delivery location and time.
items.text: mera order gurgaon ke sector 14 me hai uska time badal do

items.context: Would morning delivery work for you instead of evening?
items.text: kya aap mera delivery time badal kar kal subah kar sakte ho

items.context: Could you please confirm your order name and new preferred date?
items.text: mera naam priya hai aur mujhe mera order Jaipur ke liye reschedule karna hai

items.context: Do you want to move your delivery to tomorrow evening?
items.text: mera ghar Noida sector 37 me hai kya aap delivery kal shaam ko kar sakte hain
mera order kal aane wala tha magar main kal ghar par nahi rahunga isliye delivery ko agle hafte tak badal do
main mumbai me rehata hun mera address Bandra west aur mujhe delivery timing 10 baje subah karwana hai
mera naam arjun hai main haridwar se bol raha hun mera delivery 25 tareekh ka tha usko 27 ko bhej do
kya aap mera delivery time shift kar sakte hain mujhe apne office jane ka plan bana hai
meri gari kharab ho gayi hai isliye main apni delivery do din baad lene aunga address delhi hai mera
mera order jo tha use mai kal dopahar ke badle shaam 6 baje le sakta hun agar possible ho to batana
maine order diya tha bina kisi delay ke lekin ab karna hai delivery ko agle Wednesday tak move karna hai

items.context: When do you want us to reschedule your delivery?
items.text: mera naam sunita hai aur wahan main busy rahungi toh delivery ko kal se agle din ke liye karoge kya

items.context: Could you share your preferred date for the delivery reschedule?
items.text: mera order amritsar ke address pe aana tha mujhe kal office jaana padega toh delivery ko day after kal pe daal do

items.context: Do you want to change your delivery date or time for the same day?
items.text: mujhe bataya gaya tha ki delivery 15 ko hogi par mujhe change karna hai ki wo 18 tarikh ko ho jaye

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: reschedule - wants the delivery on a different day or time
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
